value_add: rocketchat-valueadd-release-version-in-sync (info): root package.json version equals apps/meteor, core-typings and rest-typings (the changesets fixed group) and apps/meteor/rocketchat.info. release-action bumpFileVersions only string-replaces the houston updateFiles, so drift goes unnoticed. Holds at the pin (9.1.0-develop).
rocketchat-valueadd-durability-node-matches-volta (info): update-version-durability.yml hard-codes node-version 24.15.0 instead of reading volta.node. Holds at the pin.
rocketchat-valueadd-yarn-pins-agree (info): volta.yarn and packageManager (yarn@…) equal engines.yarn. Only engines.yarn against yarnPath is enforced. Holds at the pin.

rocketchat-valueadd-workspace-volta-extends (info): every workspace manifest sets volta.extends to the root package.json. Fires 3 info findings at the pin: packages/media-signaling, packages/mp3-encoder and ee/packages/media-calls lack it; 99 of 102 have it.
rocketchat-valueadd-locale-indent (info): locale files keep the 2-space indent that .editorconfig declares and fix mode writes (JSON.stringify(…, null, 2)). Holds.
rocketchat-valueadd-locale-no-bom (info): locale files carry no UTF-8 BOM. Holds.
absent_categories: No .nvmrc, .node-version or .tool-versions. Node is pinned only in package.json volta and engines (and the Dockerfile FROM tags), so the toolchain-pins bundle has nothing to read.

No one-version-per-dependency policy tool (no syncpack, manypkg, sherif, yarn constraints / yarn.config.cjs, Yarn catalogs). Internal deps use workspace: and 58 peer deps use plain ranges, but nothing checks external ranges for consistency.
No pre-commit hooks (no husky, lefthook, .pre-commit-config.yaml or committed hooks dir).
No CI outside GitHub Actions (no GitLab, CircleCI, Azure, Jenkins, Buildkite).
No Makefile, justfile or Taskfile; the build tool is yarn scripts plus Turborepo.
No license or SPDX header checks.
No gate on the livechat locales (packages/livechat/src/i18n/*.json, 59 files) or on packages/onboarding-ui/.i18n.
No PR-title CI workflow in the repo; the "Invalid PR Title" label comes from an external bot and is only honored by kodiak's blocking_labels.
No codegen freshness (generate && git diff --exit-code) gate.
No API snapshot or golden-file compatibility gate over committed files.
No CODEOWNERS-driven validation beyond review routing (CODEOWNERS alone is not a unit).
unusual: The i18n linter (packages/i18n/src/scripts/check.mts) is a task runner with a --fix mode. It deliberately leaves find-sprintf-params out of the default set ("lenient by default") because of the backlog, so sprintf-style positional params are not enforced.

Locale files have no final newline, against .editorconfig insert_final_newline=true. The trim-eof task forbids any trailing whitespace and writeResource emits JSON.stringify(…, null, 2) with no newline, so the editorconfig is not enforced for *.i18n.json.
Several docs/i18n.md conventions are violated at the pin and are therefore not units (R5): dotted keys with a namespace prefix (23 violations) and camelCase placeholders (22 violations).
sort-base-keys uses ICU localeCompare('en') on lowercased keys, with integer-like keys first and a code-unit tiebreak. alint's lexical-ci order disagrees at en line 67.
Ratchet gates in CI: scan-style-props --max 0, scan-raw-layout --max 1024, and a spacing-scale baseline that may only shrink (scripts/spacing-scale).
The dependabot npm cooldown is documented as mirroring .yarnrc.yml npmMinimalAgeGate (3d), with npmPreapprovedPackages for @rocket.chat/*. That is a cross-tool keep-in-sync pin.

A committed Yarn plugin (plugin-engines.cjs) turns engines into a hard gate on every install and every script run, including inside the Docker builder (ee/apps/Dockerfile runs yarn workspaces focus on node:24.22.1).
The Dockerfiles use node:24.22.1 while volta.node is 24.15.0. Both satisfy engines.node; nothing keeps them equal.

release-action regexes compatibleMongoVersions out of ci.yml (getMetadata.ts:10) and silently returns [] on no match. It is a soft dependency on workflow text, not a gate, and ci.yml carries the value twice (:285, :1318).
The docs link checker (scripts/check-docs-links.mjs) has its own unit test in the same workflow, and it compares path case against directory listings so macOS cannot hide a case mismatch.

ee/packages/xmpp-server is developed spec-first: intents, specs with YAML frontmatter, plans, 16 ADRs and a compliance matrix. Known-defect anchors in test comments and spec D-entries form a 16-to-16 bijection at the pin. Its Claude skills are symlinked from the repo root's .claude/skills.
The repo carries agent-instruction files (root CLAUDE.md, ee/packages/xmpp-server/CLAUDE.md, .github/agents/*.md) that restate the review conventions; they add no new mechanical gate.
The image-size tracker (ci.yml:577-599) sets size-thresholds but no fail-thresholds, so it is advisory only.
The Qase CSV README documents its own Python validation snippet and claims CRLF line endings, but the file is LF at the pin.
SVG cleanliness rules in docs/frontend/adding-icons.md are violated at the pin (56 files carry a fill attribute), so they are not enforced.

File-graph edges: docs markdown links (content regex, A); xmpp test comments to spec anchors (content regex, B-adapter); import layering via oxlint no-restricted-imports and the xmpp protocol-core isolation (imports, D).

Reproduced the fire tests for every locale, dep-version and toolchain-pin A unit on my own scratch copies. 03: an extra key in de fires (de.i18n.json:7198). 06: fires on a pt-BR value and on a ru plural 'few' form. 07: fires on a trailing LF, NBSP, BOM and U+2028. 12: fires on de.json and .DS_Store; a subdirectory does not fire. 15: fires on a range or a missing value. 18: fires on a deleted plugin and on yarnPath set to 4.18.2, which also fires rule 17. 24: fires on a 7d gate. 25: a renamed dependency fires once; a renamed package fires 16 times. 26: the typia patch fires once; the @react-aria i18n patch fires twice. rocketchat-valueadd-locale-no-bom is mislabelled as value-add. readFile(...,'utf8') does not strip a BOM, so JSON.parse in common.mts readResource throws on a leading BOM, and the gate rejects it. alint's JSON reader accepts the BOM, so locale-parses passes. Only locale-object-root (\A[ \t\r\n]*\{) catches it at error level, so the no-BOM clause is part of enforced unit rocketchat-11 and belongs in its rule set at error, not info.

rocketchat-docs-links-resolve (unit 28) lacks root: {url_prefix: '/', dir: '.'}. A root-absolute link to a missing file (/docs/nope.md) passes, but scripts/check-docs-links.mjs rejects it. With the root map the rule fires on it, and the clone still passes. HTML <a href> links are not checked at all (see the reclassification).
rocketchat-docs-anchors-resolve (unit 29) would flag valid <a id>/<a name> anchors that the repo's checker accepts. This is a latent false positive: none occur at the pin.

rocketchat-changeset-packages-are-workspaces (unit 32): the extract regex requires a major|minor|patch bump, so a frontmatter entry with an invalid or misspelled bump type is never extracted, and an unknown package there passes. changeset version rejects both.

rocketchat-changeset-fixed-group-are-workspaces (unit 33) reads only $.fixed[*][*]. Changesets validates linked and ignore members the same way. Both are [] at the pin, so this is latent; adding $.linked[*][*] and $.ignore[*] would match the gate. The changelog module @rocket.chat/release-changelog is resolved by module resolution (D), not by this rule.

rocketchat-i18n-no-double-underscore-placeholders (unit 06) uses search(@, '__[^\n\r]*__'). The gate's JS regex /__(.*?)__/ has a '.' that also excludes U+2028/U+2029, so a value with __ on both sides of a U+2028 fires in alint but is not touched by the gate. This edge case does not occur at the pin.

Unit 05's summary ('every CLDR category its locale needs') overstates the gate. find-missing-plurals requires only the categories in (en's categories for that key) intersected with (the locale's CLDR set), and only when the locale's value is already an object. The bucket (B-adapter) is unaffected.

Unit 15: the config comment saying setup-node needs an exact version is inaccurate, because setup-node accepts ranges. The exactness requirement comes from Volta's volta.node pin and is consistent with scripts/check-deps.sh. I did not verify the setup-node behavior offline.
Unit 38 combines two behaviors (compliance mirrors spec frontmatter, and the matrix is never edited on its own). I split out the second as missed unit rocketchat-85 (C, pair_changed_together).

stage_b_summary:
Stage B for RocketChat/Rocket.Chat at fb1d4217d8c56957fe49310308f95b8a2cd6c926. Stage A's record is solid on the i18n gate (check.mts tasks): I reproduced all 9 locale, dep-version and toolchain-pin A fire tests and C unit 11, and the config validates (28 rules) and passes on the clone with 3 value-add info findings.

I found 11 missed units. Most are in places Stage A did not read: docs/npm-publishing.md, docs/typescript-7-migration.md and the xmpp-server docs. Each counted A or C unit has a rule that passes on the clone and fires on scratch:
- 76: repository.url exact (npm 422). A.
- 77: repository.directory equals the package's own directory. A.
- 78: release.yml path fixed for trusted publishing. A, lower confidence; could be D as external state.
- 79: release job has id-token: write. A.
- 80: npm >= 11.5.1. toolchain-pin, B-adapter (semver range).
- 81: react-i18next consumers on the TS7 range, livechat excepted. dep-version, A, fire-verified.
- 82: en.i18n.json exists (build.mts throws otherwise). locale, A, fire-verified.
- 83: xmpp spec frontmatter code/tests paths resolve. C (two registry_paths_resolve rules with different bases).
- 84: xmpp specs follow the template's H2 sequence. A.
- 85: compliance.md never edited on its own. C (git kind on a depth-1 clone), split out of 38.
- 86: fuselage check-dist-env. D (build output).

Reclassifications: 29 to C, because <a id|name> anchors the repo accepts are false positives in alint. 28 to C, because HTML <a href> links are not checked and root-absolute links need a root map. Removals: none.

Config issues:
- The locale-no-bom value-add is actually enforced: JSON.parse rejects a BOM, and only locale-object-root catches it.
- The unit 32 regex skips invalid bump types.
- Unit 33 omits linked and ignore (latent).
- Unit 06 has a U+2028 edge case.
- Unit 05's summary overstates the gate.

Considered and rejected:
- The oxlint anti-trojan-source no-bidi rule is part of linter unit 52 (D, R2).
- The getMetadata engines throw is incidental to release-notes rendering, which agrees with Stage A.
- check-deps.sh is run by hand only, so yarn-pins-agree stays value-add.
- 46 stays B-adapter: changeset_requires_path requires an added changeset but cannot check that it bumps @rocket.chat/icons minor.
- 44 stays B-adapter: a cross_file registered test with source glob packages/icons/src/**/*.svg gave 62 false 'x.dir' members, because .dir.svg icons map to glyph names differently and the source takes no excludes.

Revised counts if accepted: 86 units, A 23, B-config 1, B-adapter 19, C 6, D 37. coverage_today = 23/49 = 47%, coverage_with_tuning = 29/49 = 59%, gap = 20/49 = 41%.

Method:
- The clone is depth 1. Analysis read files only, using grep/sed plus my own `python3 -I` one-liners over files. Nothing from the repository ran.
- R4 fire tests split CONFIG into one config per rule, verbatim, so each test exercises the exact rule text. For every scratch copy (only the files the rule reads, relative paths kept) the run checked three things: it passes unbroken, it fires once broken, and it passes on the clone.
- All 9 A units in the locale, toolchain-pin and dep-version families were fire-verified: 03, 06, 07, 12, 15, 18, 24, 25, 26. C units 11 and 17, and A units 31, 32, 33, 36, 37 and 48, were also fire-tested.
- The scratch directory <scratch>/RocketChat-Rocket.Chat-a was removed.

Configuration choices:
- Every rule whose source or targets cover the workspaces uses the brace glob {package.json,apps/*/package.json,packages/*/package.json,ee/apps/*/package.json,ee/packages/*/package.json}: 103 files.
- registry_paths_resolve accepts a glob source; this matches the corpus tensorflow precedent.
- The cross_file dependabot extract uses a regex because a YAML extract of default-days returns a number and is refused.
- The C unit rocketchat-34 (PR title) is a comment only, because git-history kinds are excluded.

Not counted:
- The release-action getMetadata throw on missing root engines (incidental).
- bumpFileVersions (a silent replace, no check).
- The Mongo-version regex (soft).
- track-image-sizes (advisory).
- Conventions violated at the pin (i18n namespaces and camelCase placeholders, SVG fill attributes, Qase CRLF, editorconfig final newline).
